item.title: SCP-5618:
item.content:encoded:
You're getting a lot of negative comments about this, but I think it's pretty damn near perfect. Using the footnotes for the back and forth between the characters was jarring at first but by the 4th annotation it was an easy switch. I think if the Foundation was real they'd use something like a discussion page for those sorts of conversations but this was a wonderful way to include it as part of the skip.

And that ending. I thought it achieved exactly what you aimed for.

Easiest +1 I've ever had.

item.title: SCP-5512:
item.content:encoded:
I liked the details in it. Very extensive and thought out.
Strangely enough I was more invested in how things seem to be coming together then the actual SCP, with the characters from the last two SCPs I read in the series. I also liked how you involved the UIU. Love those guys.

Anyways, take the +1 my man.

item.title: SCP-5127: Re: Staff Post - Deletion Vote
SCP-5156: Revisions.
item.content:encoded:
Even if I can't, I want to say a few things.

First Problem: There is no formatting. If you want your SCP class object to be taken seriously, than at least add some formatting.

Second Problem: I see a lot of SCP-096 in here. Some more editing to more distinguish this from 096 is necessary.

Third Problem: The Exploration files need a lot of work, primarily focused on the usage of formatting and content.

Fourth Problem: not structured that well. then again, Formatting.

Look at How To Write An SCP, it should help you get some of this together more.

item.title: SCP-5914:
item.content:encoded:
Hi Author, I can see you've put a lot of time and effort into this, so I'm sure you're feeling a tad disappointed at the down votes. I have a few questions for you:

  • Did you get your idea looked at by experienced critters on the Idea Critique Forum?
  • If you did, and got the required greenlights (assuming you're a first time author), did you get your draft looked over in the Draft Critique Forum?
  • I mean this in the most polite way possible, but is English your first language? Much of this is very difficult to follow because of the wording, grammatical errors and sentence structure.

It doesn't look like this is going to survive. In future, I'd recommend using the resources I mentioned to ensure your future articles survive.

Good luck!

item.title: SCP-5914: ABOUT THE REACTION GOD!
item.content:encoded:
The "Reaction God". This SCP was inspired by some of the reacting fanfiction stories where the characters were gathered by "gods" to watch alternate lives/alternate universes/different realities.

As I also edit a few aspects of this "god", yes, I was also aware of its personality.

No, it is not a god. As stated, it belongs to a race of cosmic entities that are superior to gods.

And what makes it classified as an Apollyon was that this reaction god can end something that is greater than reality, and a regular universe. It just doesn't have any intentions in doing so, only for now.

Fun fact: Search "The Barrelplex" on google.

I mean, I've added "Reaction God" with " for a reason, you know?!
